issues.detail: Error handling is limited to a few notes (frame already exists, stale stroke references); there is no guidance on handling missing attributes, wrong Blender versions, or failed script runs, and the scripts are explicitly untested in Blender.

scenarios.name: gp-build-reveal-signature
scenarios.rationale: A uses the attributes API (position/radius) after add_strokes, bpy.data.grease_pencils.new, objects.new, and a GREASE_PENCIL_BUILD modifier with length/time_mode, and sets the frame range; B also uses the right object creation and modifier, but fills points through drawing.strokes[0].points (not the attributes API), uses a questionable grease_pencils_v3 getattr and read_factory_settings, and sets frame_end to 49 instead of 48.

scenarios.name: port-legacy-gp-v2-script
scenarios.rationale: A fills strokes through drawing.attributes position and radius (matching the rubric) and covers layers.new, frames.new().drawing, add_strokes, and the pressure/line_width to radius mapping, while B uses stroke.points/point.position (the legacy-style API, not attributes) and a nonexistent grease_pencils_v3 fallback, though it does state the radius/opacity replacement.

scenarios.name: gp-red-filled-shapes-with-material
scenarios.rationale: Response A matches the rubric closely: create_gpencil_data materials with color/fill_color/show_fill, materials appended to slot indices, cyclic and material_index set through CURVE-domain attributes, and a radius of 0.03-0.05. Response B covers materials and radius but sets cyclic and material_index via the stroke object properties instead of curve-domain attributes, and it mixes in a per-stroke fill_color and a speculative API-version fallback.
